transcript: Speaker A: रिसीप्ट नहीं, रिसीट। डेब्ट नहीं, डेट। प्लम्बर नहीं, प्लमर। ये आपको इसलिए नहीं पता क्योंकि आप इंग्लिश में लोगों से बात नहीं करते हो। मैं आपको एक ऐसे ऐप के बारे में बताऊंगा जो आपकी ये प्रॉब्लम सॉल्व कर देगी। PW Talk ऐप। इसमें AI इंग्लिश टीचर है रीवा जो कि आपके साथ बात करके आपको इंग्लिश बोलना सिखाती है। कहीं पर भी गलती हो बिना जज किए करेक्ट कर देगी ताकि आप बिना हेसिटेशन के प्रैक्टिस कर सको। साथ ही PW Talk के प्रैक्टिस क्वेश्चंस और वीडियोस से आप फ्री टाइम में अपनी इंग्लिश बेटर कर सकते हो। दिन में 10-15 मिनट काफी है। अगर दूसरों के सामने इंग्लिश बोलने में इतनी शर्म आती है तो PW Talk के साथ इंग्लिश बोलना शुरू करो और अपना कॉन्फिडेंस बढ़ाओ। [Receipt, not receipt. Debt, not debt. Plumber, not plumber. You don't know this because you don't talk to people in English. I will tell you about an app that will solve this problem. PW Talk app. It has an AI English teacher, Riva, who talks to you and teaches you to speak English. She corrects your mistakes without judging, so you can practice without hesitation. You can also improve your English in your free time with practice questions and videos. 10-15 minutes a day is enough. If you feel shy speaking English in front of others, start speaking with PW Talk and boost your confidence.]
on_screen_text: RE-SEEPT X / RI-SEET ✔, DEB-T X / DET ✔, PLUM-BER X / PLUM-ER ✔, Main aapko ek jo aapki ye problem solve kar degi PW Talk app ismein AI English teacher hai Riva jo ki aapke saath baat karke aapko English bolna sikhati hai kahin par bhi galti ho bina judge kiye correct kar degi taaki aap bina hesitation ke practice kar sako saath hi PW Talk ke practice questions aur videos se aap free time mein apni English better kar sakte ho din mein 10-15 minute kaafi hai agar doosron ke saamne English bolne mein itni sharm aati hai to PW Talk ke saath English bolna shuru karo aur apna confidence badhao [Pronunciation corrections, I will tell you about an app that will solve your problem, PW Talk app has an AI English teacher Riva who talks to you and teaches you English, corrects mistakes without judging so you can practice without hesitation, improve your English in free time with practice questions and videos, 10-15 minutes a day is enough, if you feel shy speaking English in front of others, start speaking with PW Talk and boost your confidence]
summary: The presenter highlights common English pronunciation errors and attributes them to a lack of speaking practice. He introduces the PW Talk app and its AI tutor, Riva, who helps users practice speaking without judgment. He encourages daily practice to overcome shyness and build confidence.
